summary.en: Two construction lines run across the sheet, then the title is traced in left to right over them; Chinese uses the em box as its guides.
summary.zh: 两条构造线先横穿图面，然后标题沿着它们从左到右写出；中文以字身框作构造线。

fits: Every title and claim line of a blueprint film; any drafted lettering.
notFor: Lettering that must read at once (a URL held still); body text under 50 px (guides crowd it).

intent.en: Letters are drafted, not placed: guide lines first, then the word traced in reading order.
intent.zh: 字是画出来的，不是摆上去的：先打构造线，再按阅读顺序写出。

content.en: A label and one or two title lines.
content.zh: 一个标签和一两行标题。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子的每个标题和主张行；任何“画出来”的字。

notFor.zh: 必须一眼读到的字（静止的网址）；50 px 以下的正文（构造线会挤）。

en: Chinese guides sit on the em box, not the cap line: a cap line through Chinese characters cuts them at 70 % and reads as a strike-through.
zh: 中文构造线放在字身框上，而不是大写线：大写线会在 70% 高处穿过汉字，看起来像删除线。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
